name: Pork Carnitas
time: ~9 hr, ~50 min hands-on (mostly slow cooker; estimated)
notes: For burritos, casseroles, tacos, etc. Delicious!

items: 5 lb pork shoulder, skinless, bone-in (4 lb if boneless)
1½ Tbsp table salt or 2 Tbsp kosher salt
1 jalapeno, seeded and ribs removed, chopped
Juice of 2 oranges (or equivalent with lime juice and some sugar)

steps.title: Rinse and dry the pork
steps.body: Rinse and dry **5 lb pork shoulder**, skinless, bone-in (4 lb if boneless).

steps.title: Rub the pork
steps.body: Combine **1½ Tbsp table salt** or **2 Tbsp kosher salt**, **1 tsp black pepper**, **1 Tbsp dried oregano**, **2 tsp ground cumin** and **1 Tbsp olive oil**, and rub into meat.

steps.title: Add the aromatics
steps.body: Place pork in a slow cooker, fat cap up, and top with **1 onion**, coarsely chopped, **1 jalapeno**, seeded and ribs removed, chopped, **4 cloves garlic**, minced, and **juice of 2 oranges** (or equivalent with lime juice and some sugar).

steps.title: Slow cook
steps.body: Cook on low for 8-10 hours, or on high for 6 hours, until meat is tender and falling off the bone.

steps.title: Shred the pork
steps.body: Remove from the slow cooker and cool slightly, then shred, using two forks.

steps.title: Reduce the juices
steps.body: Skim off the fat from the juices remaining in the slow cooker. Discard the fat, and reduce remaining juices to **½–2 cups**.

steps.title: Crisp the pork
steps.body: To serve, heat **1 Tbsp oil** in a large non-stick pan over high heat. Place shredded pork into the pan and press down and cook until the bottom side is golden brown and crusty. Pour warmed juices over meat and serve immediately. Do not skip these steps!

steps.title: Reheat
steps.body: To reheat, warm in an oiled pan and cook the other side briefly, just to warm through—just leave one side crusty.

steps.title: Freeze
steps.body: To freeze, pour juices over the pulled pork and store in ziplock bags. To use, defrost completely, then follow instructions to serve.
